answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7688 Country: India Title: It is seen in makkah haram sharif that muqtadi pray salaat with jamaat ahead of imam in front of kaaba. is this allowed? Question: It is seen in makkah haram sharif that muqtadi pray salaat with jamaat ahead of imam in front of kaaba. is this allowed? Answer ID: 7688 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1885/292=TB/1429) It is not so in the Masjid Al-Haram. But, if you observed that some muqtadis queue up ahead of Imam in congregational salah then their salah shall not be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
